sources.entry: Publify - Simple but full featured web publishing software. (Source Code) MIT Ruby

summary.one_liner: Publify is a self-hostable Ruby on Rails blogging and publishing platform (formerly Typo) with a short-message feature that connects to Twitter.
summary.what_it_does: Publify is a multi-user blogging engine built on Ruby on Rails, with a small message system connected to Twitter for short posts. It supports text filters for Markdown, SmartyPants, @mention linking and #hashtag linking, plus a widgets system and a plugin API. Users can create custom themes and the README mentions advanced SEO capabilities. The interface is translated into many languages, including English, French, German, Japanese and Simplified Chinese. The project follows IndieWeb principles of self-hosting your own site.
how_to_run: Unzip the Publify archive and rename database.yml.yourEngine to database.yml, then add your database settings
notable: Described as the oldest Ruby on Rails open source project still alive, dating to 2004
Supports Markdown, SmartyPants and @mention/#hashtag text filters
Includes a widgets system, plugin API and custom themes
Has a documented Heroku deployment path using Amazon S3 for uploads
caveats: The README says master branch may be broken and is not recommended for production
Requires CRuby 2.5 to 2.7 and Rails 5.2.x, which are older versions
Heroku deployment requires Amazon S3 for file uploads and Gemfile changes
